notes.title: 🌱Playtest Round 2 is Live! Thank You for Your Support 🐾
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Farmers!

A huge thank you to everyone who participated in our first Playtest! 🙏 Every piece of feedback and every suggestion you shared has been an invaluable treasure for our development. It's with your support that Your Big, Cute Monster Farm continues to grow and improve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674482/026e36ebae79ec7c723a47488431d3b2777bae97.png[/img]

Following the first playtest, we received a great deal of feedback regarding game stability, crashes, and various bugs. To address these issues at their core and provide a much smoother gameplay experience, we have significantly refactored and optimized the game's underlying architecture.

Unfortunately, this means that save data from the first playtest cannot be carried over to this new round. We know this is a major inconvenience, and we sincerely apologize. However, this architectural overhaul was essential for improving game stability and ensuring your monster companions can serve you better than ever! Furthermore, based on your invaluable suggestions, we've made several other optimizations and adjustments. Let's dive in and see what's new!

[h3]New Features & Adjustments[/h3]

- Added a window resizing feature.
- Added a feature for lower scenes to automatically collapse for better visibility.
- Optimized the new player tutorial tasks.
- Improved the Talent description pop-up!
- Added a new Talent for mushroom gathering and removed the "All-Rounder" Talent.
- Optimized monster display logic.
- Added a "Move" button in the monster details window, allowing you to reposition monsters directly from the pop-up.
- Improved the appearance of some buildings.
- The Data Center now shows income-per-minute data.
- Fixed issues with mouse cursor offset.
- Fixed various other tricky bugs.


We welcome you to join the second round of the Monster Farm: An Idle Story Playtest! Every piece of feedback you provide will be listened to carefully and will directly influence the development of the final release. Let's work together to make this the game you've always wanted to play!

[h2]Add the game to your Wishlist! Your monster companions are already waiting for you on the new farm! 🌾[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3659410/_/

notes.title: v0.1.20 Playtest Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] A confirmation popup will now appear when selling high-quality phantasm beasts.
[*] Added a move button in the detailed view of a phantasm beast, allowing players to change its position.
[/list]
[h2]Optimizations / Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized the display of the phantasm beast’s range: when selecting a deployed beast, the affected farmland will now show a hint box.
[*] Improved default sorting of phantasm beasts, now from highest to lowest quality.
[*] Optimized behavior when phantasm beasts are moved behind buildings.
[*] Reduced lag when selling phantasm beasts.
[*] Improved filter functionality.
[*] Fixed a bug where beast names were displayed repeatedly.
[*] Fixed an issue related to range-based talents.
[/list]

notes.title: 🎉"Your Big, Cute Monster Farm" is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
🌾 Hey there, dear farmers!

Welcome to a laid-back world of farming with monster buddies!

The game lives at the bottom of your screen, where you’ll enjoy sowing, watering, and harvesting with your monster buddies. No need to get your hands dirty — your monsters will take care of all the farming! All you have to do is plan your layout, decorate your farm, and wait for surprising crop mutations to bloom. Take a break from busy work or study and enjoy the simple joy of growing and harvesting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674482/4e5a91b671ad5831142ff44fbbf059de96bff960.gif[/img]
